About Maddy

Maddy

Owner - Lead Tutor

Hello! My name is Maddy, dedicated music instructor with a Bachelor of Arts in Popular Music and Worship Arts from Catawba College. My experience extends beyond the classroom, having performed my own shows, managed artists, and worked as a songwriter and music producer. Since 2020, I have been teaching private lessons, guiding over 24 students on their musical journeys. I'm excited to bring my practical experience and passion for music to your lessons!

Johan Hernandez

"Maddy was an amazing piano instructor for me. I was very much a beginner in playing piano with not a lot of patience for it and she provided multiple helpful exercises that helped me get over that amateur hurdle and into being a more professional player. Stephen Green

"Maddy was our daughter's piano teacher for about a year. She is an exceptionally talented and a dedicated instructor who played a significant role in fostering my daughter's love for music.

From the very first lesson, Maddy demonstrated not only remarkable skill and knowledge, but also an incredible ability to connect with our young daughter. She tailored her teaching style to my daughter's learning pace, making every lesson engaging and inspiring. Her patience, encouragement, and enthusiasm helped my daughter build confidence and develop a genuine passion for piano. And when a break was needed, they found fun ways to learn and talk about music that opened our daughter's eyes and heart to appreciate music on a larger level. We even threw in a few drum lessons to broaden her musical skill.

Beyond teaching technical skills, Maddy instilled a deep appreciation for music, introducing a variety of styles and ensuring that learning remained both structured and enjoyable. My daughter always looked forward to her lessons and made tremendous progress under Maddy's guidance.

I highly recommend Maddy to anyone seeking an outstanding piano teacher. She is not only an excellent educator but also a wonderful mentor who makes a lasting impact on her students. Any student would be fortunate to learn from her!"

Rebecca Perez

"I must say, working with Maddy as her former employer was such a fantastic experience! She is an amazing music teacher for guitar, piano, and drums. Her passion for music really shines through in every lesson she teaches.

Maddy has this incredible knack for connecting with her students. She makes learning fun and easy, breaking down tricky concepts so everyone can understand. It was awesome to see how she tailored her lessons to fit each student's style and interests, creating a super supportive vibe.

Not to mention, her warm personality made her a favorite among both students and staff. She always brought a positive energy that inspired everyone around her. If you're looking for a skilled and dedicated music teacher, Maddy is definitely the one! She is a true gem in the music world!"
